doi: not applicable (doctoral thesis, Universite de Pau et des Pays de l'Adour, defended 14 Nov 2019; no DOI in PDF)
journal: PhD thesis, Universite de Pau et des Pays de l'Adour (Caracterisation thermodynamique des equilibres entre phases liquide et vapeur dans les saumures a hautes pressions et temperatures)
experimental_method: Stirred variable-volume autoclave; liquid sample trapped in NaOH and dissolved CO2 determined by titration (acid-base, conductimetric for Ca-containing brines); each reported molality is the mean of five (or eight for the repeatability study) titrations.
uncertainties_stated: ANOVA relative uncertainty 2.8 percent (0.03 mol/kg at 1.07 mol/kg), extended to all CO2 solubilities.
quality_remarks: Thesis data tables IV-5, IV-7, IV-9, IV-11, IV-12, IV-13, IV-14 (6+5+1+5+5+5+5 = 32 rows) are identical, digit for digit, to Tables 6 and 7 of Lara Cruz et al., J. Chem. Eng. Data 2021 (extract/10.1021_acs.jced.0c00592: 12 validation + 20 brine rows): same pressures, molalities, temperatures and salinities. They are therefore DUPLICATES and are not re-extracted to avoid double counting; the thesis adds the per-row absolute uncertainty column (0.01-0.04 mol/kg), whereas the journal gives relative uncertainty 0.028. Only Tableau IV-3 (individual titrations of CO2 in pure water, 10.0 MPa, 333.15 K) is not in the journal paper and is extracted. Table IV-3 mean of Experience 1 printed 1.0736 vs 1.07354 computed from printed values (rounding).
